rules.E84-P1: zeros at least as fast as random data in every format: clock(zeros) - clock(heavy) >= -10 MHz for fp32 (heavy = randn), fp16 (randn) and int8 (full), in the burst cell and in the sustained cell (all samples of the last 40 s): six comparisons, all must hold
rules.E84-P2: int8 the least throttled: with deficit = 800 MHz - clock, deficit(int8 full) <= deficit(fp16 randn) + 5 MHz and <= deficit(fp32 randn) + 5 MHz, in the burst cells and in the sustained cells: both must hold
rules.E84-P3: the limiting test read from the trace ring (burst: the first throttle-down line in the work; sustained: the last-40-s labels of reduce_e84.py) equals this file's label for >= 9 of the 11 kinds in the burst block and >= 9 of 11 in the sustained block; a kind is right only if every one of its runs carries the label
rules.E84-S1: secondary: P2 on the format means of the sustained deficit over all the kinds measured (fp32 five kinds, fp16 three, int8 three)
rules.under_resolved: P1 with fewer than six comparisons, P2 with fewer than two, P3 with fewer than 11 kinds in a block cannot PASS (a FAIL already decided by the cells present stands)
rules.not_scored: the expect_* ranges are context for reading the result, never verdicts; nothing is fitted to the data
